tools.name: scan_repo
tools.description: Run vu1nz's 6 deterministic CI/CD security checks against any public GitHub repository's workflow files. Returns findings with severity, file, line, CWE, and recommendation.

tools.name: threat_feed
tools.description: Recent malicious packages caught in the wild across npm, pip, cargo, rubygems. Sourced from OSV.dev with a curated fallback list (Shai-Hulud, Polyfill.io, ctx, ua-parser-js, etc.).

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: The catalog of CI/CD security checks vu1nz runs, each mapped to a CWE. Use to explain to a user what vu1nz would catch on their PRs.

tools.name: list_advisories
tools.description: vu1nz-published security advisories with date, severity, and summary.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: All vu1nz blog posts: supply-chain analysis, release notes, security research. Returns slug, title, date, tags, summary, and URL.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Full content of a vu1nz blog post by slug.

tools.name: check_license
tools.description: Look up the vu1nz subscription status for a GitHub org. Bootstraps a 14-day free trial on first call. Returns ok, status (trialing/active/past_due/cancelled/exempt), days remaining, license_key, and upgrade URL.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List your vu1nz webhook endpoints and the event types vu1nz emits (scan.completed, scan.failed). Needs an API key.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Add a webhook endpoint (public https URL). Returns the endpoint and its signing secret (shown once). Needs an API key.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Remove one of your webhook endpoints by id. Needs an API key.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a webhook.test event to one of your endpoints now and report the result. Needs an API key.

tools.name: webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Recent webhook deliveries (status, attempts, last HTTP status), optionally for one endpoint. Needs an API key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_webhook" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Add a webhook endpoint (public https URL). Returns the endpoint and its signing secret (shown once). Needs an API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: threat_feed, list_checks, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, check_license · Private data: scan_repo, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, webhook_deliveries · Public sink: get_blog_post, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, webhook_deliveries · Destructive: scan_repo, delete_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: threat_feed, list_checks, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, check_license · Private data: scan_repo, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, webhook_deliveries · Public sink: get_blog_post, list_webhooks, create_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, webhook_deliveries · Destructive: scan_repo, delete_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
